dispersion_interpretation_note: For 025/026, evaluate five paired B/A ratios using relative dispersion (max-min)/median. If wall or process-CPU relative dispersion remains above 5% after five pairs, report the observed median but treat the speed direction as uncertain rather than a stable speedup. 027 has only three unique measured pairs; pairs 4-5 reuse its pair-3 outputs as verifier controls and add no repeatability evidence. Assess peak-memory behavior separately; a stable memory reduction does not establish stable speed improvement.
limitations: This is fixed-500 measurement and output-pairing evidence only; it does not accept full-universe 5,471-symbol performance.

025/026 each have five actual pairs in AB/BA/AB/BA/AB order; 027 has only three actual pairs in AB/BA/AB order. The pair-4/5 027 verifier slots reuse pair-3 outputs and are not new measured comparisons.
If a five-pair 025/026 wall or process-CPU relative dispersion remains above 5%, the speed result remains uncertain; do not turn the median alone into a stable-speedup claim.
memory_measurement_note: Per-run reported_peak_bytes is max(main_peak_working_set_bytes, resource_peak_tree_rss_bytes) as emitted by the benchmark result. Both source fields are retained separately; this summary does not relabel the combined value as a pure RSS measurement.
phase_timing_scope_note: The benchmark runner's phase timers are coarse nested timers. Inclusive phase values overlap; exclusive values subtract observed child time. They support stage attribution but do not prove that a candidate caused a change.
